<p class="pub-meta"><span class="pub-self">Arnison, T.</span>. <span class="pub-journal">Frontiers in Psychology</span>, 14. 2023.</p>

::: {.pub-summary}
An opinion piece arguing that adolescence, when both insomnia and chronic pain most often begin, is the right time to intervene, and that early psychological treatment should be prioritised over treating established, comorbid problems later.
